about: The site's delivery in a real browser (tools/ci/site-browser.sh, tools/ci/site-perf.mjs): the built page served as Pages serves it (gzip), a cold visit over a 20 Mbit/s, 40 ms connection at 1280×800, then to the features and back. Bytes, milliseconds.

budgets.why: 4.4 MB (2026-11-02): the wasm 2.4 compressed, the fonts 2.0; nothing fetched after the first frame. C2's goal is under 5 MB (the master plan, W8)

3.3 MB on the way to the first frame (2026-11-02): the program and the Latin fonts; the Chinese font (1.4 MB) comes just after it unless the page opens in Chinese (dist-toy's font languages). Next (performance tiers §7): the first frame drawn ahead, the program split
1.8 s locally (2.3 s with the Chinese font before it, 3.1 s before the site's places were pages; 2026-11-02): the transfer at 20 Mbit/s is most of it; a slower runner's headroom
